explanationMd: The second paragraph explicitly contrasts unequal time resources with unequal income resources. An aggregate reduction in waiting therefore does not settle how the new burden falls across users.

distractorRationale.c: Time savings do not guarantee universal affordability.
distractorRationale.b: The passage does not reject free provision.
distractorRationale.d: Urgency is a separate allocation priority.
distractorRationale.e: It substitutes or changes costs rather than removing them.
